fields.contract: MapSqlShardKeyAttribute : MapShardKeyAttribute configures an attributed ShardKey<TRecord>, ShardKey<TRecord, TChild>, ShardKey<TRecord, TChild, TGrandChild>, or ShardKey<TRecord, TChild, TGrandChild, TGreatGrandChild> (or nullable equivalent) property for SQL Server parameter and result mapping. All 10 constructor overloads require recordIdName and may additionally accept shardIdName, childIdName, grandChildIdName, greatGrandChildIdName, and isRecordIdentifier (defaulting isRecordIdentifier to true when omitted). When shardIdName is supplied, it creates an internal MapToSqlSmallIntAttribute(shardIdName, false) for the shard identifier slot; each record/child component name must match a sibling MapToSql*Attribute on the same property (or MapAttributeMissingException is thrown). On hydration from DbDataReader or output DbParameterCollection, the mapper resolves each configured component column or parameter, checks column/parameter presence and DBNull status (terminating model hydration with null/default when a component marked IsRecordIdentifier is missing or DBNull), and constructs the target ShardKey<...> when all key components are non-null (or assigns ShardKey<...>.Empty / null when any component is null).
